name: Project Desk
description:
Agents can move work across ten projects at once. Your attention is one decision at a time. Project Desk closes that gap: many agents, many projects, one desk reflecting exactly what needs you next.

As agents work, they automatically update the shape of the project, file tickets, record handoffs, return decisions to you, and close what ships. The board becomes a byproduct of the work — not another tracker you have to maintain.

Two queues separate judgment from execution. The Attention Queue holds what only you can do: decisions, reviews, walks, and approvals. The Agent Queue holds scoped work with a clear proof of done. Because agent-ready work from every project gathers in one place, a single agent can keep making progress across your portfolio unattended — even overnight — without stopping at every handoff.

Project Desk never opens your repositories or scans your machine. Your coding agents work only with the access you give them, then reflects the project context you approve into your authenticated, isolated desk.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Project Desk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Project Desk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://atlier.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Project Desk MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Project Desk provides these MCP tools: atlier_handoff, atlier_issue, atlier_issue_close, atlier_issue_move, atlier_issue_update, atlier_project_archive, atlier_project_scan, atlier_project_unarchive, atlier_return_resolve, atlier_update_project, atlier_project_remove_preview, and atlier_project_remove.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Project Desk?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Project Desk in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Project Desk MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Project Desk requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Project Desk is developed by Wilds Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
